title: Putting the Object First: Én a focit szeretem

sections.content: Hungarian word order is flexible, and moving the object before the verb -- and before the subject pronoun -- puts extra focus on it, similar to English 'Football, I like.' The verb still agrees with the object as definite.

items.english: As for me, I like football.
As for me, I like music.

sections.content: This fronting is optional, not required -- 'Szeretem a focit' is equally correct and more neutral. Use the fronted order when you want to contrast your preference with someone else's, as Anna does in the conversation.
